entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production RTS animation sprite sheet. Reference has SIX ROWS of character types and FOUR COLUMNS of evolution levels. Use ONLY THE FIRST COLUMN (level 1) of the reference for each of its six rows. Keep every unit's EXACT species, face, gender, clothing, armor colors, weapon, vehicle and equipment. Rows in EXACT reference order: engineer worker with tool; rifle recruit; heavy machine-gunner; female combat medic; tracked battle tank; biped armored exosuit. For EVERY row, columns 1-4 are four DISTINCT sequential WALK cycle keyframes: left stride, crossing passing pose, right stride, second passing pose. Humanoids have clearly changing shoulder/elbow/wrist swing counterbalancing leg strides, arms actually DRAWN in different anatomical poses. Keep original weapon type: sword/axe swings, bow draws and releases, rifles/cannons recoil, staff/hand casts, claws/jaws bite/slash. No giant projectiles or effects covering the body. These must be new drawn poses, not copies or scaled/squashed bodies. Consistent fixed foot or hover baseline, body size, three-quarter RIGHT facing game camera and lighting for each row across all eight columns. Keep heads, full weapons, wings and tails within each cell with transparent padding; no crossing cells, no cropping. Detailed realistic 3D-painted game sprites matching reference style. No ground/environment/shadow slab. No buildings. Each row must have the SAME unit in all 8 frames, never mix evolution armor or unit types.
